name: edgedesk-sports
description: EdgeDesk Sports — a static research terminal plus the deterministic football pipelines that feed it. No dependencies: every script here runs on a bare Node install, and the browser reads committed artifacts rather than computing anything.

scripts.cfb:rebuild: npm run cfb:box && npm run cfb:players && npm run cfb:rankings && npm run cfb:test
scripts.cfb:test: node football/players/players.test.js && node football/rankings/rankings.test.js && node tools/football/player_quality_ui.test.js && node tools/football/rankings_ui.test.js
scripts.games:test: node tools/games/games.test.js && node tools/games/state_parity.test.js && node tools/games/attribution_parity.test.js && node tools/games/builder.test.js && node tools/games/social.test.js && node tools/games/sql_security.test.js
scripts.test: node football/tests.js && node football/cfb_p4/tests.js && node football/rating/edr.test.js && node football/availability/availability.test.js && node football/injuries/fetch_injuries.test.js && node football/players/players.test.js && node football/rankings/rankings.test.js && node tools/football/player_quality_ui.test.js && node tools/football/rankings_ui.test.js && node tools/app/navigation.test.js && node tools/app/research_landing.test.js && node tools/app/game_research.test.js && node tools/app/operator_gate.test.js && node tools/presentation/landing_positioning.test.js && node tools/presentation/landing_interaction.test.js && node collective/tests.js && node collective/tests_render.js && npm run games:test
